about: Incorporated in 2012, M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Ltd. is engaged in the retail sale of gold, diamond, and CZ jewellery through its showroom network across Mumbai and Ahmedabad.

The company offers rings, necklaces, bangles, earrings, bracelets, Mangalsutras, solitaires, bridal jewellery, and customised jewellery under multiple collections such as Pavitra, Rivaaz, Sitaare, NAQSH, Sunhere, and One & Only.
The company operates 5 retail showrooms across Maharashtra and Gujarat in high-footfall locations including Bandra, Andheri, Zaveri Bazaar, C.G. Road, and Sindhu Bhavan Road.

Its business model focuses on retail jewellery sales, customer-centric collections, customised jewellery offerings, and diversified designs across multiple price points. The company procures finished jewellery from third-party vendors across Western India.
As on June 30, 2026, the company offered more than 19,442 SKUs, including over 14,582 gold jewellery designs and 4,860 diamond and precious stone jewellery designs.
The company caters to bridal, festive, daily wear, and premium jewellery customers with BIS Hallmark-certified jewellery products.
As on September 30, 2026 the company had 148 permanent employees.

about: Incorporated in 2011, Ajwa Projects is a multi-disciplinary industrial services company delivering end-to-end solutions across fabrication, erection, piping, pressure equipment, prefabricated structures, civil construction, and maintenance. The company specializes in turning project plans into real, functional industrial assets. The company manufacture technological frameworks, industrial buildings, girders, heavy modules, platforms, and crane girders that are critical for plant construction and infrastructure projects. They also fabricate specialised components such as dish ends, crowns, petals, and customised parts, including diesel engine components for railway applications that require a high degree of precision and strict compliance with industry standards.

Key Services: Fabrication: Manufacture and sell structural components, pressure vessels, boilers, tanks, ducts, and precision parts for various industries.
Erection: On-site installation and integration of heavy structures, equipment, and piping systems with strict focus on safety and precision.
Piping: Fabrication and installation of process and utility pipelines for chemicals, gases, steam, and fluids.
Pressure Equipment: Fabrication, assembly, and erection of pressure vessels and related heavy-duty equipment.
Civil Construction: Site development, foundations, industrial buildings, silos, tanks, and other civil works.
Prefabricated Structures: Modular and portable buildings for industrial and commercial use.
Maintenance & Mechanical Services: Preventive maintenance, PSV calibration, NDT testing, blasting & painting, and plant shutdown support.

about: Incorporated in August 2009, Carver Roboweld Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of welding consumables, including Metal Cored Wires, Welding Rods and Gauging Electrodes, along with the supply of welding spare parts and accessories. The Company has also expanded its offerings to provide value-added engineering solutions to the forging industry, including forging die regeneration and welding robot rental services.

The Company operates its primary manufacturing facility in Bamanbore, Rajkot, Gujarat, with additional service units in Pune, Hosur and Ludhiana, enabling it to serve customers across key industrial markets in India. As of July 11, 2026, the Company had an aggregate installed production capacity of 650 tonnes per annum for Metal Cored Wires and Welding Rods, reflecting a capacity CAGR of approximately 30% between Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2026.

Through its subsidiary, Carver Engineering Private Limited, acquired in September 2025, the Company also provides re-conditioning and refurbishment services for plant and machinery across industries such as forging, casting, cement, steel, sugar, power, petroleum, automotive and fabrication. Its engineering services include heavy-duty machining, structural fabrication, repair and refurbishment of hammers and components, and turnkey engineering projects.

The Company has a presence across several Indian states and caters to industrial customers through its welding consumables and engineering solutions. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified and is a Sustaining Corporate Member of the American Welding Society (AWS), reflecting its focus on quality management and adherence to international welding standards.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 68 permanent employees and 75 contract workers.

Strategic market coverage across domestic industrial markets.
Focus on meeting customer specifications and quality standards.
Integrated manufacturing and value-added engineering service capabilities.
Experienced promoter and management team with strong welding industry expertise.
Robot rental model supporting long-term customer engagement and recurring revenue.

about: Incorporated in December 2019, Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited is a steel processing centre engaged in converting steel coils into value-added processed steel products for Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) and Original Design Manufacturers (“ODMs”). The Company specialises in precision slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing and embossing of steel coils to manufacture slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks. Its products serve multiple end-use industries, including home and commercial appliances, automotive and auto components, electrical equipment, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, ventilation systems and general engineering. In addition to processing steel coils, the Company provides logistics and inventory management services and supports customers through just-in-time delivery solutions.

The Company operates four strategically located manufacturing facilities at Wada and Bhiwandi in Maharashtra, Ghiloth in Rajasthan, and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh. Spread across an aggregate area of 42,209 square metres, these facilities are equipped with slitting, cut-to-length, shearing and embossing lines. The Company has an authorised service partnership with JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (“JSWSCPL”) and/or its holding company since 2021, supporting regular access to steel coils. As of June 30, 2026, its aggregate installed processing capacity was 1,23,153 metric tonnes per annum, calculated on a quarterly basis for Fiscal 2027.

The Company serves a diversified customer base across consumer durables, home appliances, refrigeration, automotive, electrical equipment, electronics, industrial engineering and other manufacturing sectors. Its customers include OEMs and ODMs such as Haier Appliances India Private Limited, IFB Refrigeration Limited, Dixon Electro Manufacturing Private Limited, Amber Enterprises India Limited and Western Refrigeration Private Limited.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 164 personnel, comprising 160 permanent employees and 4 employees on retainership.

about: Incorporated in September 2022, Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited is a precision engineering company engaged in the manufacturing, trading and servicing of critical components for underwater pelletizing systems. The Company manufactures a range of components for underwater pelletizing systems, including pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades and knives, blade holders, cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes and other spare parts. Its products cater to polymer compounding, masterbatches, engineering plastics, cable compounds, specialty polymers and plastics recycling industries. The Company also undertakes customised manufacturing based on customer specifications and offers white-label manufacturing, enabling customers to market products under their own brands. Its business operates through three segments: manufacturing, services and trading.

The Company commenced operations at its company-owned manufacturing facility at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara, Gujarat, in July 2025 and has progressively transitioned manufacturing activities from its earlier leased facility in Makarpura, Vadodara. Its manufacturing infrastructure includes precision machining and testing equipment such as VMC, CNC, milling, EDM, wire-cut, lathe and surface-grinding machines. Certain specialised processes, including heat treatment, hardening and coating, are outsourced to job workers. The Company also provides refurbishment and repair services for used die plates, intermediary support for the marketing and supply of CJTEK components, and management consulting services for developing customer relationships.

The Company serves customers across India and international markets, including the USA, Germany, the Netherlands, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Japan, Australia, Italy and other countries. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for manufacturing and supplying pelletizing system components and received ZED Bronze Certification under the MSME Sustainable Certification Scheme in November 2025. Its operations are supported by an experienced promoter and management team, technical personnel and dedicated sales and marketing capabilities.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 71 full-time employees, excluding Directors, across production and operations, quality and testing, design, sales and marketing, finance, administration and other functions.

about: Incorporated on November 12, 2020, Johnsoncab Electricals Limited originated as a partnership firm named M/s. Johnson Cables in February 2012. It is engaged in the manufacturing of low-voltage wires and cables rated up to 1.1 kV and markets its products under the brand name “JOHNSON CABLES”, catering to power infrastructure, renewable energy, railways and industrial applications.The Company’s product portfolio includes control cables, power cables, industrial single-core and multicore cables, house and building wires, welding cables, solar/photovoltaic cables and submersible flat cables. Its products are designed for applications across power transmission and distribution, renewable energy integration, industrial operations and allied sectors. The Company holds ISO and BIS certifications to support product quality and compliance with applicable standards.

Johnsoncab Electricals operates two manufacturing units in Mehsana, Gujarat, with a combined annual installed manufacturing capacity of 79,950 kilometres as of Fiscal 2026. Its facilities are equipped with machinery for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing and packaging. The Company has upgraded its manufacturing infrastructure with automatic and semi-automatic machinery to improve production capabilities and cater to varied product specifications.

The Company serves both government entities and private-sector customers through direct orders, tender participation and vendor approval processes. Revenue from operations increased from ₹88.34 crore in Fiscal 2024 to ₹210.47 crore in Fiscal 2026. For the five months ended August 31, 2026, the Company reported revenue from operations of ₹113.04 crore, EBITDA of ₹15.32 crore and profit after tax of ₹8.63 crore.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 193 employees across production, operations, finance, human resources, quality assurance, sales and marketing, supply chain, logistics and information technology.

about: Vedant Poly Fabs Limited was incorporated in December 2018 and manufactures flexible packaging materials for businesses across India. The company operates as a B2B supplier and offers a diverse range of packaging products, including 3-layer and 5-layer LD films, shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches, catering to industries such as food & beverages and other consumer goods.

Since commencing operations, the company has expanded its product portfolio, strengthened its manufacturing capabilities, and established dedicated teams across sales, design, production, logistics, and dispatch. In March 2026, it further increased manufacturing capacity by adding lamination, slitting, and pouching machines, and installed a reprocessing unit to improve resource utilization and recycle manufacturing waste.
The company follows an integrated manufacturing process covering raw material procurement, film extrusion, printing, lamination, slitting, quality control, packing, and dispatch.
